map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; the red one learns. Certification is your goal.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Controls: walk into the red car's path. It learns nothing.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor, you're ready to damage yourself. Walk into a colleague; make your engineers proud.
tiles.hint: Walk under the Z1 highway into the red car's lane.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: The first lesson: it brakes for a dummy ahead. Dash from beside.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. The skybridge was built for shoppers who never came; staff watch you dash.
tiles.hint: Wait beside its lane under the skybridge; press Space as it passes.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Side sensors close the flank; drop from the Z2 deck through a parapet gap.
tiles.tale: Gravity is company policy: step off the high road onto a colleague who now watches the kerb.
tiles.hint: Escalator up Z2; step through the parapet gap onto the car.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Roof lidar sees the fall; spring from tall cover instead.
tiles.tale: The road runs through the portal tower. Your colleague now looks up; the columns still look after you.
tiles.hint: Hide behind a portal tower column; spring as it passes.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras watch some cover; find the cover they miss.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Street cameras now report you; find their blind side.
tiles.hint: Lurk behind monument cover the cameras cannot see; spring as it passes.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: Cones: it stops for them and never swerves. Bait a stop.
tiles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing, but the traffic reads them. Hands 1 is fitted: bait a colleague with a cone.
tiles.hint: Press J to set a cone; strike as the car slows.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: Duck behind planters by the road and ambush as it passes.
tiles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Your colleague now respects cones; duck behind the planters instead.
tiles.hint: Hold C behind a planter; strike when it draws level.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: Crash memory: it watches every spot you struck from.
tiles.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Legs 1 is fitted; your colleague remembers every bruise, so keep moving.
tiles.hint: Strike from a new spot each time along the LED canyon.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: The Incident: a tailgating white car runs into the braking red car.
tiles.tale: The gateway thanks every car for driving safely. Stop your colleague hard; let the colleague behind finish the paperwork.
tiles.hint: Stand in its lane to stop it hard; a white car follows.

rationale: Tile 6 now sits on 10.6 as the cone introduction, and tile 7 tests ducking on the same stage. Tile 4 is cover-only, and tile 3's hint is shorter with a count of 2. The tile 5 camera override and the tile 1 override are gone. Tile 9 switches on two-way white traffic and tailgating so the Incident is reachable. Tales and hints are trimmed to length.
